input.quote: 13.1 Vendor grants Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.
input.rationale: Section 13.1 grants the Services licence to "Customer alone", expressly "without Affiliates or contractors", and makes it "revocable at Vendor's sole discretion" — walk-away territory: affiliates and contractors are excluded with no path to add them (the defined "Customer" is Meridian Fieldworks alone and does not include Affiliates), and the licence is revocable at will. This fails even the fallback (affiliates covered on written notice) and contradicts the retained revocation limit in 13.3. The reconciling provisions already deliver the remaining preferred elements: 13.2 gives a perpetual, irrevocable paid-up licence to Customer and its Affiliates, and 13.3 (with 24.1) permits transfer of licence rights to an Affiliate or successor. Our single edit to 13.1 extends the Services licence to Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf and replaces discretionary revocation with termination only for uncured material breach; deleting "non-transferable" also removes the conflict with the 13.3 transfer right.

proposal.summary: Extend the Services licence to Affiliates and contractors and remove Vendor's discretionary revocation.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Services licence in 13.1 to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, and replaced revocation at Vendor's sole discretion with termination only for our uncured material breach, consistent with Sections 13.2 and 13.3.
